newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CONCEICAO JOINS FELLOW BRAZILIANS AT DEPORTIVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CONCEICAO JOINS FELLOW BRAZILIANS AT DEPORTIVO.

text.p: Spain's Deportivo Coruna have beaten Real Madrid in a battle to sign Brazilian Olympic midfielder Flavio Conceicao from Palmeiras.
Deportivo club president Augusto Lendoiro said on Tuesday the deal would not cost more than $6.5 million despite a late offer from Real worth $7.0 million.
The 22-year-old is expected to sign on Wednesday, joining compatriots Mauro Silva and Rivaldo and Brazilian-born Donato -- now a naturalised Spaniard -- at the Galician club.
Deportivo has become a favourite destination for Brazilian players because of similarities between the regional Galician language and Portuguese.
